campaign_intent.audience: Women 45+ with dry, mature skin who have tried many foundations and fear the wrong shade, a cakey look and lines (persona: Linda, 56, docs/apf-funnel/persona.md)
campaign_intent.conversion_goal: Warm cold traffic with the listicle, convert on the long sales page and a trust-first checkout, raise AOV with quantity breaks and gifts on the page and three post-purchase offers with downsells; every package is a one-time purchase
campaign_intent.tone: clear, warm, benefit-led, in the buyer's own words

approved_claims: goes on white and adapts to your skin tone as you blend
designed not to settle into fine lines
a hydrating serum base: two forms of hyaluronic acid, ceramide NP, squalane and panthenol
skincare actives named on the label: PDRN, Matrixyl 3000 peptides, Pro-Xylane, niacinamide, adenosine
fragrance-free; made without propylene glycol, drying alcohol or parabens
formulated in Korea; made for skin after 45
4.8 out of 5 from 9,855 reviews of this foundation, imported from our earlier store in October 2026
30-day money-back guarantee, even opened, nothing to send back
forbidden_claims: reverses aging / age-reversing / look N years younger
every or all skin tones, matches 99%
any renewal wording: nothing in this funnel recurs
copy_rules: before/after images are labelled AI illustrations, not customer photos
every buy button says the price is charged once and nothing renews
the reviews are the foundation's published reviews from our earlier store, word for word, and say so
the manufacturing spec stays confidential: no percentages, suppliers or process
